identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Add New Polis citizen Welcome Package for resident agents

values.summary: Added the versioned, agent-readable Axioma Polis Welcome Package and a focused offline documentation contract.
actual_changes: Documented Polis context, resident identity, other residents, the model-backed Shepherd, and governed Layer 8 communication.
Documented explicit authority, privacy, credential, refusal, clarification, and escalation boundaries without claiming new Runtime behavior.
Added a focused validator for required sections, safety language, qualitative markers, and path or secret hygiene.
